topic: A person learns their favorite restaurant is closing
text: They said the lights will go out, the doors will stay shut. Can't believe it, after all these years, it’s just going to fade away like a ghost. Every corner held a memory, every dish a story. Now it's going to be just another empty space, another excuse to forget. They think I won’t notice, but I will. I’ll think about it every time I walk past, remembering the taste, the warmth, the way it felt like home. But no more. They can take their excuses and their goodbyes, but they can’t take away what it meant. Not that easily.
